recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-26876 unless PA opens a new tracker for contact semantics beyond the approved ExtendedContactDetail model.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue asked whether Organization.contact should use Location rather than Address to capture location-specific business identifiers, status, alias, and similar details.
initial_application: No FHIR-26876-tagged source commit was found. The relevant model was applied through the R5 contact issue family: FHIR-29035 created ExtendedContactDetail, FHIR-29034 changed Organization.contact from BackboneElement to ExtendedContactDetail, and FHIR-27005 confirmed that ExtendedContactDetail satisfied missing Organization contact period needs.
additional_context: FHIR-25375 handled the parallel Location.contact use case with ExtendedContactDetail. The seed comments record the submitter reviewing the R5 model and reporting no issues with most use cases, and PA minutes on 2023-03-29 explicitly record FHIR-26876 as already updated in R5 with prior changes.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source/fhir.ini includes Organization as an active resource and ExtendedContactDetail as an active normative data type; source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml defines Organization.contact as 0..* ExtendedContactDetail.
